## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `c9ad209e24dd7810875aff1ddfe1abaad1a5508c` · 2026-11-25T17:50Z

PR #37298, PR 2 of 2 for #37229 (the `skills/**` half). Read against GitHub and the tree, not against the report. One should-fix is open, in the changeset; the three skill hunks themselves hold.

### Checklist

- **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Refs #37229`, no closing keyword on any card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37298`: CLEAN, 13 items read, none flagged). Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- **Diff, read whole.** 4 files, +14 / −4 against merge base `dfdebfadd5`: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L111, `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L6 and L7, `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89, and the new `.changeset/37229-skills-protocol-19.md`. Four lines rewritten in place; net 0 lines in `skills/**`. No file outside the card.
- **Premise.** #37230 merged (2026-11-25T12:51Z, `5cf9941d3f`). `git grep "protocol: '\^18'" -- skills/` at this head matches nothing. The eval's prompt and expected output moved together, and its `must_contain` list names no range.
- **Declarations.** Body and changeset both read `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` through `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine`. That is right from content: skill prose and one eval fixture, nothing the runtime accepts or refuses. `patch` on `@objectstack/skills` follows. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
- **Gates (check-runs at this head).** 30 success, 18 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both success; `mergeable_state` read `clean`, then `unknown` after `main` moved. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `dbc1765a24` is clean.
- **Tier.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37298`: GOVERNED, `skills/**` ×3, Tier H. `record-recognisers.mjs --template` on the four paths: the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- **Skills value density.** Byte-equal rewrites of one digit each; no growth, no budget question.
- **Landing order.** The body says it: "This PR lands with PR 1 or right after it, and after #37230", "It stays draft until then", and the Order-risk note. The 速读's fourth line says the same. On `main` without PR 1 the taught `'^19'` is refused by the 18 runtime, so PR 2 must not land before PR 1 (#37314).

### Changeset, sentence by sentence (`.changeset/37229-skills-protocol-19.md`)

- Summary line and the first two sentences of the body: true against the diff and against PR 1.
- Last sentence, tail clause: see S1.

### Findings

- S1 (should-fix) — the changeset's last sentence ends "no conversion is registered at step 19, so the chain an author replays still ends at 18." The first half stays true (PR 1's `step19` has `conversionIds: []`). The second half is false on any tree that holds PR 1, which is the only tree this PR may land on: `CHAIN_TERMINUS_MAJOR = Math.max(PROTOCOL_MAJOR, ...MIGRATION_MAJORS)` is 19 there, and the CLI prints `Chain:  protocol 18 → 19 (this runtime implements protocol 19)` (measured on PR 1's head `e05fdf6f18` with the built CLI). The sentence ships in `@objectstack/skills`' `CHANGELOG.md`. Fix in the changeset only: drop the tail clause, or say that step 19 carries no conversion and one semantic entry (`protocol-18-range-refused`). The head has to move anyway (K, below), so this costs no extra round.
- N1 — body, Acceptance notes: "No conversion or semantic entry is registered at step 19 on `main` `dfdebfad` … so there is no step-19 text to teach yet" is true at `dfdebfad` and stale once PR 1 lands (one semantic entry). The skill teaches one procedure, so nothing in `skills/**` needs to follow. Seat-side body edit.
- N2 — `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89 now says "every scaffold and example writes … `'^19'`". On `main` the `create-objectstack` blank template keeps `'^18'` until the version pass stamps it; the two ship together at `19.0.0-next.0`, so the sentence is true where it is published. Accepted.
- N3 — the body says "lands with PR 1 or right after it". "With" must not be read as "ahead of in the same queue batch"; the approval request should say after.

### Seat-side items (no dev work)

- **Claim line.** The newest `Claim:` comment on #37229 is 7160363498. Through `readClause2Line` it reads `Clause-②: no`; through `readMetadataProtocolLine` it reads `semantic`. This body reads `no` and `none`: the `Metadata-protocol` line differs. The amendment 7161510004 is not a `Claim:` comment and carries neither line. The seat amends the claim.
- **K.** `landing-k.mjs --pr 37298`: PRBASE `875ae40f85`, K = 21 on `origin/main` `dbc1765a24`, hold at 15; shared-budget leg: this PR and `main` after PRBASE both touch the skills token ratchet. MERGE MAIN FIRST (exit 1). Do it after PR 1 is on `main`, in the same push as S1.
- **Closing keyword.** PR 1 says `Fixes #37229` and this PR says `Refs`. As written the card closes when PR 1 merges, with this half still open. Decide which PR closes the card and say so on both.

### Verdict

REWORK, one patch round: S1 in the changeset, with the owed merge of `main` after PR 1. The contract-review record on this head is PASS (`record-37298.md`); the changeset is a prose face, so that record does not judge S1. No hand-off is written until S1 is closed.

The examples write `'^19'` at #37314's head; the blank template is stamped `'^19'` by the version pass that publishes this skill. The lines left alone hold: L74 `--from 16 --to 18` is an explicit `--to` on a worked 16 → 18 walk and still replays; L91 teaches reading the floor of a range; L122 and L178 to L183 are statements about 18.x releases.
- No must-fix, no should-fix on the three files. One should-fix sits outside this record's scope, in the changeset (the seat's L1, S1).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3536f9ac1c83edb66f981fb1105beef2e2409843`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json, skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md + none
Security-touching: no

Delta record on the head that follows `c9ad209e` (record 7170101896, PASS). Read: cards #37460 and #37229 with every comment, the PR body, the net diff against `main` `a46efa8c62` (4 files, +14 / −4), and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built or run; the tree was read with `git show`, `git diff` and `git grep`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face.** Three `skills/**` paths, the rules face. No file in the diff implements or enforces them, so the scope is `+ none`. `.changeset/37229-skills-protocol-19.md` is the lane seat's read; it is judged here only where ② and the brief's questions touch it.
- **Accept sets and public surface: none moves.** The hunks are one line of a `defineStack` example, one eval's prompt and expected output, and one sentence of the upgrade skill. The refusal of `'^18'` is PR #37314's, already on `main`.
- **The landing condition of the earlier record is met.** `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts:27` reads `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '19.0.0'` on `main` and at this head. In `packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`, `alternativeMajorSpan` reads `'^18'` as the span 18 to 18, so `checkProtocolCompat` against major 19 answers `incompatible` with `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` and `objectstack migrate meta --from 18`; `'^19'` answers `ok`. So `'^19'` is the range the runtime on `main` admits, and `'^18'` is the one it refuses.
- **"The three skill files are byte-identical to `c9ad209e`" holds for two files, not three.** Blob ids at `c9ad209e` and at this head:
  - `evals/config-plugins-ops.json`: `bdbacba6` and `bdbacba6`, identical.
  - `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`: `b39d35c8` and `b39d35c8`, identical.
  - `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`: `15bff12b` and `d4ba63f9`, different. The difference is exactly what `main` brought in through the merge (#37409 and #37303: the object-naming paragraph, the context-pack wording, the layout paragraph, the `record-context` row). This PR's own hunk, L111, is unchanged, and against `main` the file differs by that one line.
  The claim is in the PR body, the dev report 7185131089 and the final-head comment 7185487162. The tree is right; the sentence is not. See N3.
- **Check-runs on this head:** 30 success, 18 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending, counted from the API. `Lint & Repo Gates` (which runs `check:skill-examples`, `check:skill-compatibility` and the skills token ratchet), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Plan Test Core shards` are all success. So `check:skill-examples`, which the dev did not re-run locally, is answered by CI on the merged platform file.

### ② Semver level

- `'@objectstack/skills': patch` is right. The diff publishes skill prose and one eval fixture: 0 net lines in `skills/**`, nothing added to or removed from the catalog. `@objectstack/skills` is in the fixed group with `@objectstack/spec` and `.changeset/pre.json` is in pre mode, so the text ships at `19.0.0-next.N` beside the runtime it describes.
- `Clause-②: no` holds, and `Metadata-protocol: none` with it. The PR body and the changeset carry the same pair. Nothing a metadata author can write changes, and nothing the runtime accepts or refuses changes in this diff.
- The changeset's step-19 sentence is true in the tree. `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` L3724 to L3738: `step19` has `toMajor: 19` and `conversionIds: []`. `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` has keys 11, 15, 17 and 18 and no 19, and `conversions/entries/` has no `19` folder. Under `migrations/entries/` the only `19.*` file is `semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts`, whose `id` is `protocol-18-range-refused`; there is no `19.*` file under `retired-keys/` or `retired-defs/`. S1: closed.
- The sentence is a reading of this head. Step 19 is "accumulating, uncut" by its own docblock, so later v19 entries will add to it; a changelog line dated to its release is the normal shape, and nothing is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev report 7185131089, `open_questions` 1** (the PR body edit and the assignee are the seat's writes, not the dev's): answered. The body on GitHub now reads `Fixes #37460`, carries the rework section and is signed by the seat.
- **`open_questions` 2** (`Plan Test Core shards` failed at checkout): answered. The flake judgement is comment 7185173626, one re-run, and the check-run is success on this head.
- **Deviations** (model-free commit trailers; three local gate families not measured for want of a full build): accepted. CI ran those families and `Lint & Repo Gates` is success.
- **`security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`:** agreed for this diff.
- **PR body, "noted, not filed"** (nothing cross-checks a `protocol:` literal in skill prose against `PROTOCOL_VERSION`): a gate proposal, not a defect of this diff. N1 below is a second instance of the same gap, so the seat may want one follow-up card for both.
- **SQL push-down:** no query code in the diff.
- **Security:** no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour. The handshake the example feeds is a compatibility check, not an access check.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L111** — holds. The example declares `engines: { protocol: '^19' }`, which the handshake on `main` admits. The paragraph under it (L115 to L119: stamped by `create-objectstack`, checked before anything loads, refused with the exact migration command) matches `checkProtocolCompat`. The block is under `os:check` and its gate is green on this head.

**`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L6 and L7** — holds. The prompt asks for `protocol 19` and the expected output names `'^19'`; they agree with each other and with L111. The `assertions` block is untouched and names no major: `must_contain` is `defineStack`, `manifest`, `engines`, `Object.values(`, and `must_not_contain` is `workflows:`, `approvals:`, `tableName:`. An answer written from the new prompt satisfies it exactly as before. The rest of the expected output (`crm_`-prefixed names, no object-level `namespace`, no `tableName`) still agrees with the platform skill after the merge: the `manifest.namespace` paragraph keeps the `crm_` prefix rule.

**`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89** — holds. The sentence says what scaffolds and examples write. The six example manifests on `main` write `'^19'`. See N2 for the blank template.

**No `'^18'` is left in `skills/**` that teaches the current major.** `git grep` at this head for `^18`, `protocol 18`, `--to 18` and `--from 18` under `skills/` returns two lines, and neither is an instruction for the current version:
- `objectstack-data/rules/indexing.md:66`, "REFUSED since protocol 18": a dated fact, still true.
- `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:74`, `--from 16 --to 18`: a worked example. See N1.

Also read and left alone, correctly: the upgrade skill's L91 (`'^17'` to `--from 17`, the floor of a range), L108 (a branch name), L119 to L122 (17.x installs and the 18 catalog), L178 to L183 (18.3 and 18.2 release facts), and the upgrade eval's `'^16'` and `--to 17` forms.

**The upgrade skill's `--from` and `--to` guidance with step 19 present** — holds, checked against `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`:
- `--to` defaults to `CHAIN_TERMINUS_MAJOR`, which is now 19, so "replay 16 → current" (L142) and "`--to` defaults to the highest major this build carries a step for" (L406) are true as written.
- "`--from` the target major proves nothing … or it holds only the next major's step" (L406 to L410): `--from 19` is an empty range and answers `replayedNothing` with `widestRange: null`; `--from 18` holds step 19 alone, which is one semantic entry and no conversion. Both readings are what the text says.
- "Take the floor" (L90 to L92) matches `declaredTargetMajor`, which is also what the refusal's own `migrate meta --from N` prints.
- The support floor "16 today" (L103) matches `MIGRATE_META_SUPPORT_FLOOR = 16`.
- Tried to break L74 on a 19 runtime with a manifest already at `'^19'`: `planProtocolRange` caps at `min(--to, PROTOCOL_MAJOR)` = 18, reads `'^19'` as declaring a major at or above the target and returns nothing, so the range is never lowered and no edit is reported. Hops 17 and 18 run, so `replayedNothing` is absent. The command does what its comment says.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits (none changes correctness or the contract on this head):

- N1 (nit) — `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L74, the quickstart's acceptance replay, stays `--from 16 --to 18` while steps 1 and 2 of the same quickstart replay to the default terminus, now 19, and §3.3 teaches `--to` the target major. Today the two give the same `applied`, because step 19 has `conversionIds: []`. The first major-19 conversion makes L74 an incomplete acceptance, and no gate ties the line to the terminus. Left as an accepted deviation on this head; it wants a follow-up card whose trigger is the first conversion registered at step 19. Do not fix it here: a fix moves the head.
- N2 (nit) — L89 says "every scaffold and example writes … `'^19'`". At this head `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts:38` still writes `'^18'`; `template-consistency.test.ts` pins it to the scaffolder's own major, and the version pass stamps it. The same holds for the frontmatter (`compatibility: … 18.x`, `version: "18.6.0"`), which the version pass also stamps. The skills and the scaffolder are in one fixed group, so the sentence is true in every published release. Carried from L1 7170084508 N2; accepted.
- N3 (nit) — the PR body, the dev report and the final-head comment say all three skill files are byte-identical to `c9ad209e`. `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` is not (see ①); it carries `main`'s merged hunks, and only this PR's hunk in it is unchanged. The body's reason for not re-running `check:skill-examples` locally rests on that sentence; CI's run on this head covers it. The body also says the chain "composes hops only for majors that carry a step (17 and 18)", and `MIGRATION_MAJORS` is now 17, 18 and 19. Both are seat-side body edits, before the hand-off.

Landing: `skills/**` is Tier H, so this record does not land the PR; the maintainer's approval does.
